newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks close slightly lower.
newsitem.headline: French stocks close slightly lower.

text.p: French shares closed slightly lower in quiet trade on Monday as the market continued its consolidation above the 2,100 level for the blue-chip index with some uneasiness about Thursday's public sector strike.

Generale des Eaux closed 0.5 percent higher at 590 francs before reporting after the close a rise in the first-half net profit to 808 million francs and said it expected a full-year profit of around 1.8 billion francs.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index was down 3.50 points or 0.16 percent at 2,143.62 while the CAC-40 futures contract was down at 2,149.5 from 2,152.50 on Friday 's close.

Brokers said the CAC index's inability to break above the 2,150-60 level signalled that the market needs to consolidate further. The bourse did not react to the Bank of France's weekly tender at which it left its interest rates unchanged.
Volume was 2.8 billion francs as turnover was modest reflecting partly the Columbus-day partial holiday in the U.S.

Retailer Carrefour was down 1.62 percent at 2,847 on market rumours that it may seek to acquire control of Comptoirs Modernes, in which it holds a 23 percent stake. A Carrefour spokeswoman said no such negotiations were under way.
